lines.x: Gavial doesn't do this kind of work, and nobody in the tribe wants to do this stuff either. So, that's why I help out a bit when I have the time.
If there's no trainee nurse at the Medical Department, I can give it a try. I have some basic nursing knowledge.
Doctor, this pen seems to be out of ink. Oh, wait! Please don't throw that out! If it's not too much to ask... Um... could I have that?
I can't dig up the floors on Rhodes Island? There's no buried treasure? But where are all your precious things, then? Locked inside rooms? Oh, that's too bad…
My tail's gotten even bigger. If this keeps up, everyone's going to hate me for sure. Wuh... What do I do…?

Some people are born strong and cool, others, smart. For me, I've got a big tail... Since we can't choose what we're born with, let's embrace our uniqueness and make the most of it. Um, of course, if you could help me out every now and then, Doctor... that would be best.

I understand Gavial skipping work, but why would she skip a meal? Could something be bothering her so much that even she has to hide? And no one else even noticed. I'm the only one who can save her! Ah, Doctor, good thing you're here. Can you help me with something?

Are you sure you want to see what's inside my backpack? Okay... I haven't organized it in a while so it might be kind of messy. Let's see… An amber wrapped in a leaf. A loose fang...? A bloodstained black crystal... and a stack of autographs?! Uh, Doctor, that's all for today! Sorry, but we're done here!

She shines with such brilliance that I can't help but stare, even as her flames scorch my eyes dry. That's my Gavial, she shines like the sun. Oh, by the way, I came across that passage in a book and thought it sounded nice, so I memorized it. It really fits Gavial, doesn't it?
I'll leave this dreamcatcher over here… May you have a pure and peaceful dream, Doctor.
Hello, Doctor. Er, I'm not here to cause trouble. I'm here to… to... Study! Right, study. No reason for me to stay home alone if Gavial is here, right?
Hmm... Maybe I should just practice on the battlefield, I guess…
Thank you for giving me such a pretty badge, Doctor. What? It's a promotion badge? Ah, uh, y-you sure...? A-A-Am I really qualified to have this?
I'll be worthy of this flag one day, I swear I will.
I'll watch and learn, Doctor. It would be great if I could actually master some of your skills…
You're leaving it to me? Really?
Let's go. We are gonna F… um… beat them up!
Wait, I'm not ready yet!
Please not me, please not me…
Maybe I'll have a go…
H-Here I go!
Who needs beating? Come over!
C-Come on, you can do this!
A little more, a little more!
Haah!
Wh-Who's next!
I got beaten like that before, by you, Doctor.
We won, yay.
Phew, my back's sore. I need a break.
I'm sorry... so sorry…
Ah! Please don't throw that away yet. Can you leave it to me? I'll take care of it.
M-My tail...
Want to try Sargonian barbecue? I'll work the grill, you just enjoy the food, Doctor.
Arknights.
If today's a holiday, does that mean I can take the day off? Haghhh… Oh, where's Gavial? Have you seen her, Doctor? If I've got a free day, of course I'm going to spend it with Gavial!
Hnngh... Doctor…

Doctor! I brought you a birthday present! Umm... huh? Wh-Where did it go? I hid it behind my back so I could surprise you. How could it go missing...? Wahh… Oh! Here it is! It was stuck under my tail... Sorry about that, and happy birthday to you, Doctor. Hehe.

Doctor, I got a paper slip from the fortune box, and it says if I say five positive words to a plant every day, it will grow even bigger. Let me try it with this one! Tail, backpack, barbecue, sweet dreams... And... Gavial. Hehe... Doctor! Why are you laughing at me?
